questiontext.text: Which of the following are essential objectives of Social Studies education in Nigeria? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Social Studies aims to build responsible citizens, promote moral values, and foster problem-solving. It rejects ethnic hatred and environmental destruction.

questiontext.text: Which of the following belong to the Physical Environment? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Rivers, hills, and forests are physical environment components. Legal rulings and marriage customs belong to the social/political/cultural environment.
